628-660-2018.description:
Activate Treva's Attendant by paying {1} and sacrificing it.
When Treva's Attendant dies, Mikaeus triggers, returning Treva's Attendant from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Treva's Attendant by paying {1} and sacrificing it.
When Treva's Attendant dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Treva's Attendant from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Repeat

2281-5237-6495.easyPrerequisites: You had a permanent leave the battlefield this turn.
2281-5237-6495.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Renegade Rallier
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Renegade Rallier
When Renegade Rallier dies, Saffi triggers, returning Renegade Rallier from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Renegade Rallier enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
2281-5237-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

620-2111-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3010-3259-7296.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3010-3259-7296.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Moonblade Shinobi, triggering Breath of Fury and Moonblade Shinobi.
Resolve the Moonblade Shinobi trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

104-3263-5641-6830.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3263-5641-6830.description:
Gain life in any way.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

5003-5231-7283-7649.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Thorin.
When Thorin dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Thorin from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Thorin enters, it triggers, attaching Nim Deathmantle to Raphael, and then having Raphael deal 6 damage to itself.
Raphael triggers, adding six {R}.
Repeat.
5003-5231-7283-7649.notes: Once you have infinite mana, the damage dealt to Raphael can instead be dealt to any creature(s).

1806-2060-2511-4772-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Doubling Season.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

772-891-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2079-3259-7279.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2079-3259-7279.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker.
Razorkin Hordecaller triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

997-1090-3817.description:
Cast Restoration Angel by paying its mana cost.
When Restoration Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Restoration Angel.
Resolve the Restoration Angel ability, blinking Sister Hospitaller
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Restoration Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2033-3459-5078-5741.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

4365-5259-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
4365-5259-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Rude Awakening
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

2893-3470-4500-6664.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the basic land enters, Lotus Cobra and Retreat to Kazandu trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Retreat to Kazandu trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with three or more charge counters on it

1978-2416-2593.description:
Animate Astral Cornucopia using Rise and Shine.
Activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Astral Cornucopia.
Repeat from step 2.

719-4338-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Xenograft, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

1274-3197-6458.easyPrerequisites:
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
You have a way to gain life.
1274-3197-6458.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

944-2421-4050-6711.manaNeeded: {R}{R} if Sabin is in your graveyard or {2}{R} plus commander tax if applicable otherwise
944-2421-4050-6711.easyPrerequisites: You have an additional card in hand.
944-2421-4050-6711.description:
If Sabin is in your graveyard, cast it for its blitz cost by paying {R}{R} and discarding a card. Otherwise, cast Sabin either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Sabin and Skyfire Phoenix, adding {R}{R}.
Choose not to return Sabin to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Sabin dies, if it was cast using its blitz ability, it triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

2781-4264.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Altered Ego.
2781-4264.description:
Cast Altered Ego by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian
When Altered Ego enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Altered Ego. Choose to have Altered Ego enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.

261-3490-4659-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
261-3490-4659-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Suture Priest indestructible.
261-3490-4659-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

650-710-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

586-2393-2511-5258-5618.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Sifter of Skulls and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {3}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

428-5016.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal exactly 1 damage to Spitemare.
You have a way to give Spitemare indestructible.
428-5016.description:
Give Spitemare indestructible, if needed, and then deal exactly 1 damage to Spitemare.
Spitemare and Ghyrson Starn trigger.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 2 damage to Spitemare.
Spitemare triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Spitemare trigger from step 2, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Repeat from step 2.

373-877-2438-4484.notablePrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich died this turn.
"Zombie" chosen with Morophon.
373-877-2438-4484.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Ebondeath, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Repeat.

1061-1068.manaNeeded: {5} the first turn, with {3}{U}{U}{U} available each other turn
1061-1068.description:
Cast Leveler by paying {5}.
When Leveler enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling your library.
During your next upkeep step, activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your draw step, drawing Timestream Navigator from your library.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
Repeat from step 3 each turn.

1850-4224-4543.description:
Activate Trench Behemoth by returning Tranquil Cove from the battlefield to your hand, untapping it.
Play Tranquil Cove, triggering it and Fastbond.
Resolve the Tranquil Cove trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Fastbond trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Repeat.

uses.n: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar

147-1777-4558-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature with mana value 3 or greater.
147-1777-4558-5256.description:
Cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing a creature with mana value 3 or greater.
Extus triggers, targeting any applicable creature card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, causing target player to mill cards equal to Dualcaster Mage's power.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Burnt Offering.
Extus triggers, returning Dualcaster Mage to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Burnt Offering copy, adding at least {B/R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.
If the sacrificed creature had mana value 4 or greater, this combo nets infinite black and red mana.

618-859-1545-4613.notablePrerequisites: Lurking Roper has at least one +1/+1 counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
618-859-1545-4613.description:
Activate Lurking Roper using Kiki-Jiki's ability by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
When the Lurking Roper token enters the battlefield, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Lurking Roper's toughness.
Each Lurking Roper you control triggers, untapping themselves.
Repeat.
You may also target any nonlegendary creature you control.

2034-2773-3490-4016.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
2034-2773-3490-4016.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Warstorm Surge triggers, dealing 1 damage to Snapping Sailback.
Snapping Sailback triggers, holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Snapping Sailback trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Servo tokens.

386-5076-5280.notablePrerequisites:
Glistening Oil attached to Kederekt Parasite.
You control a red permanent.
386-5076-5280.description:
Cast Echo of Eons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing each player to shuffle their hand and graveyard into their library and draw seven cards.
Kederekt Parasite triggers for each card your opponent draw this way, giving each opponent seven poison counters.
Cast Echo of Eons from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to shuffle their hand and graveyard into their library, draw seven cards, and exile Echo of Eons.
Kederekt Parasite triggers for each card your opponent draw this way, giving each opponent seven poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

2743-3024-4615.description:
Cast Complete the Circuit by paying {5}{U}, causing you to copy the next instant or sorcery spell you cast twice.
Cast Quasiduplicate by paying {1}{U}{U}, targeting Biovisionary.
Complete the Circuit triggers, copying Quasiduplicate twice, with both copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Quasiduplicates, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

338-1071-2122-2275.notablePrerequisites:
Light of Promise attached to Mindless Automaton.
You have a way to draw a card.
338-1071-2122-2275.description:
Draw a card.
Shabraz triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and causing you to gain two life.
Mindless Automaton triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on itself.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

3940-5195.notablePrerequisites: You have cast at least three spells this turn.
3940-5195.description:
Cast Haze of Rage with buyback by paying {3}{R}, triggering its storm ability and Storm-Kiln Artist.
Resolve Haze of Rage's storm ability, creating a copy of Haze of Rage for each spell you have previously cast this turn.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers once for each copy created this way.
Resolve all Storm-Kiln Artist triggers from step 3, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Resolve each Haze of Rage copy from step 2, causing all creatures you control to get +1/+0 until end of turn for each copy.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger from step 1, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Haze of Rage, causing all creatures you control to get +1/+0 until end of turn and returning Haze of Rage to your hand.
Activate four Treasure tokens you control by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}.
Repeat.
